scope: Qwen3.8 27B Q4/Q8 targets and Q4_K_M/Q8_0/BF16 DFlash2 drafts. Fixed seven proposals. Short C1 probes; no controller or precision change. Two additional cache-addressing correctness fixes cover C1 and independent batched sessions.
retained: Pack only recurrent rows in transient rollback snapshots; copy complete groups with pitched device-to-device transfers.
Reuse existing fused QK normalization/RoPE without cache writes in DFlash2.
For Q4 convolution coefficient projection B8/M1280/K5120, process two independent groups of four tokens with the same arithmetic.
Use each session's own cache capacity and size_t KV-plane arithmetic, shared by allocation/reset/prefill/decode/verification.

memory.scope: Transient rollback, Qwen27B production FP32 recurrent state, per speculative session. Persistent snapshot format and live state precision unchanged.

operators: qwen_attention_fusion_ops_test: in-place cacheless QK/RoPE, zero query heads, positions 0/4096/16384, heads 128/256 and widths 1/7/8/16.
qwen_ssm_ops_test: packed rollback, FP32/BF16, complete/tail/no-attention/all-attention groups and repeated saves.
qwen_q4kxl_quant_ops_test: actual M1280/K5120/B8 projection against scalar decode.
quality.wide_cache_scope: 24-token prefix plus three continuation tokens at logical capacity 262144, compared with capacity 128; no full-context fill.
quality.fresh_build: Changed C++/HIP timestamps refreshed before focused rebuild to avoid stale objects after syncing files edited during an earlier build.
quality.original_target_and_conversion_qualifica: Still open; preservation controls and cache fixes do not establish original-checkpoint equivalence.

retained_kernel_checkpoint.workload: Final C1 pp2048/tg128 at depth0: paired AR controls and all six candidate DFlash2 pairings. One timed repetition after warmup per variant; every trace equals qualified AR. Short development probe, not a depth sweep or variance estimate.

checkpoint_note: All six depth0 pairings measured after all retained GPU kernel changes. Subsequent size_t/cache-addressing fixes are validated with the final release in the prefill control, 4K replay and profiles below. Short samples do not establish a small total-throughput gain.

final_prefill_control.workload: Q4 AR prefill-only, pp2048, 3 timed repetitions after warmup. Candidate first to reverse the earlier paired order. No TG or large depth sweep.

final_depth4096.workload: Final C1 pp2048/tg128 at depth4096, Q4 draft with both targets. One timed repetition after warmup. Each candidate trace equals qualified AR; this checks generation following long prefill. No repeated depth sweep or variance estimate.

final_profiles.workload: One diagnostic profile per target, Q4_K_M draft, cpp_ring_buffer chat, 128 tokens. TG begins at the first draft embedding; excludes initial prefill and draft injection. Executors are separated by HIP stream. Profile timings are not throughput estimates.

rejected.experiment: Q8 projections split into two groups of four tokens
rejected.result: Isolated wins reversed in the model; Q8-target chat throughput fell 2.6–3.1%, and matched projection GPU times increased. Q8 grouped production/test/tool variants removed.
rejected.workload: cpp_ring_buffer chat, 128 generated tokens, fixed seven proposals, two interleaved repetitions; timing includes prompt processing. Short development probe, not a full corpus or depth sweep.

rejected.experiment: Q5_K and IQ4_XS prefill up-GEMM/SwiGLU epilogues
rejected.result: All output bytes exact; component microbenchmarks improved 8–10%, but Q4 AR prefill fell 2.6% in the initial pair. IQ4-only was inconsistent: AR -0.9%, DFlash prefill effectively unchanged. Entire extension removed; existing Q8 epilogue retained.

iq4_only_probe.workload: Paired C1 pp2048/tg128, depth0: AR and Q4 drafts on both targets. One timed repetition after warmup per variant; every trace equals qualified AR. Short development probe, not a depth sweep or variance estimate.

rejected.result: Exact but neutral/slower on dominant shapes; rejected.
Narrow shapes 12–20% slower; the isolated 1.5% gain on one larger shape did not justify retention.

tooling: Replace 1590-line duplicated W8A8 benchmark with small production Q8 FFN ablation under tools/qwen27b. Extend existing normalization/projection tools and operator tests; no additional test executable or production switch.
limitations: No complete depth refresh, capability evaluation or C>1 speed sweep.
Final profiles are one diagnostic chat invocation per target with Q4 draft; timings explain components, not throughput.

compiler_resources.scope: Nix standalone production-template probe, gfx1151; not a full release ISA report.
